title: Fri 16 Oct 2026: Dow rebounds, UK GDP surprise, rate week ahead, ESMA greenwashing note
summary: Wall Street recovers as the Dow climbs more than one percent, the FTSE 100 posts its best close since late August and Asia bounces after the chip rout. UK GDP grew 0.1 percent in August, ahead of a run of Fed, Budget, ECB and Bank of England decisions. In regulation, key UK deadlines, ESMA's greenwashing note and recent SEC proposals; in funds, lessons from a capped evergreen fund. Plus three COO action points and the diary.
